label: FP
reason: The identified cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability is based on a misinterpretation of the data flow. The user input 'param' is never used in the vulnerable path. All outputs are constructed from hard-coded strings ('SafeIngrid', 'rememberMe', session attributes), and the only dynamic content comes from SecureRandom-generated integers which are then converted to strings and safely embedded into HTML via non-user-controlled variables. There is no direct concatenation of user input into output, and all user-facing strings are either hardcoded or derived from secure, non-injected sources.

evidence.note: The only user input handled is through 'param', which is ignored after being assigned to an empty string. No user input flows into the response body.
